silhouette.reason: Unmistakable T-34: sloped glacis and sides, five Christie wheels plus idler and sprocket, hex turret with twin cupola hatches, F-34 gun, rear drums/exhausts. Reads from all six views and LOD2.
fixes: soften the turret edges (cast radius) so it is not a sharp-edged box

proportions.reason: Within the 6.68 x 3.00 x 2.45 m spec; wheel, track and barrel measures pass.
fixes: check the turret ring position against a side elevation

materials.reason: The all-over camo mottle is gone: plain 4BO green with pale dust settling on the lower hull, glacis and running gear, fading with height; road wheels show green discs with dust-pale rims. The turret and upper plates are clean flat green with no break-up.
fixes: subtle roughness/value variation on the upper plates (sun-faded tops)
darker rubber showing through the dust on the tyre treads

detail.reason: Raking.png: link track with horns, dished wheels with ribs, grab rails, spare links, hatches, MG ball, fuel drums with straps, exhausts, slogan; no weld beads at plate joints, no tow cable.
fixes: tow cable along the hull side

wear.reason: Dust and mud heaviest on the lower hull and track run, lighter up the sides; the rear soot is now a soft fan round the exhausts with no blocky noise (3/4 REAR, TOP), but it is so faint it barely reads, and the dust fade on the rear deck shows triangle-faceted steps in TOP.
fixes: darken the rear soot fan one or two steps so it reads at the sheet scale
smooth the dust mask on the rear deck (finer vertex density or texture mask) so it does not step in triangles

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps outline, turret and running gear, and the hull colour now matches LOD0 (no mottle to lose); the road wheels go uniformly dark olive, losing the pale dusty rims.
fixes: keep the dust-pale rim colour on the LOD2 road wheels

technical.reason: QA PASS: 57.8k / 12.6k / 1.5k tris, 19 / 19 / 19 draws (one per moving pivot), one material.
fixes: declare real.mass (26.5 t) and a physics shell so the mass gate covers it
